indications.description: EGFR-mutated locally advanced or metastatic NSCLC in EGFR-TKI-naïve adults.

treatment.schedule_summary: Afatinib 40 mg by mouth once daily continuously until progression or unacceptable toxicity; individual dose modifications require Consultant review.
administration_instructions: Take without food: no food for ≥3 hours before and ≥1 hour after.
If missed, take the same day when remembered unless the next dose is due within 8 hours; then skip. Never double. Do not repeat a vomited dose.
If unable to swallow, pharmacy may teach the approved non-carbonated-water dispersion method; do not crush.
